description: NaHf₂(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3c space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.57 Å. Hf is bonded to six O atoms to form HfO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.04 Å) and three longer (2.09 Å) Hf-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent HfO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-36°. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.55 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Hf, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Hf and one P atom.
